name: Auto Decor
description: DECOR button in the editor: pick a style (Slaughterhouse, Tidal Wave, Acheron, 5 more) and decorate selected objects with one click.

detail.name: Detail
detail.description: 1 - light, 2 - normal, 3 - dense (more objects per target)

spread.name: Spread
spread.description: How far the decor goes from the object

size.name: Decor size
size.description: Size multiplier for the created objects

opacity.name: Opacity
opacity.description: 255 = fully opaque decor, lower = softer look

tint-presets.name: Use preset colors
tint-presets.description: Color the created objects with the style's own palette

max-targets.name: Max targets
max-targets.description: How many objects are processed per click (keeps the editor responsive)
